description:
BURREN VIEW is situated on a most wonderful site with exquisite views offering the perfect blend of rural tranquillity and urban convenience, the property is just five minutes from the villages of Maree, Oranmore, and Clarinbridge, while Galway city is just a 15-minute commute away.

The property offers convenient living just on the edge of Oranmore (3km) and close to Galway city with the benefit of space and country living, making it an ideal choice for those trading up into the long-term family home with a contemporary finish in a prime location. 

This property has easy access to local amenities - schools, shops, leisure activities, Galway Bay (sailing and golf) and beautiful natural walks in Renville Park or adjoining seaside. This location of Oranmore also allows easy access to Galway City via coast road & dual carriageway as well as train. Due to its great location this home also benefits with easy access to junction 19 with M6, M18/M17.

This family home presents with 242 sqm. and comprising reception hall/viewing room, open plan kitchen/dining/living with direct access to gardens, large utility, living room with stove, and 3 bedrooms at ground floor level.  The master is super spacious with ensuite.  At first floor level there are 2 further bedrooms and bathroom facilities. 

Outside there is a spacious garage /workshop and large turn around tarmac parking area, together with tree lined rear garden.  To the front there is ample carparking and manicured gardens .  The view here is beautiful and the kitchen opens directly to this view via patio doors.

AGENTS COMMENT     Shelagh McGann  -  this is a wonderful home just outside of Oranmore village , a beautiful setting within a few minutes of every amenity.
